slides.body: The Rasi (main birth chart) shows what is visible. The Navamsa (D-9, the ninth-harmonic chart) shows inner strength and how a promise matures.
Many apps split the difference or pick one chart. The result is vague advice that fits everyone and helps no one.

points: Compare the planet's dignity in both charts
Read Navamsa as the test of the Rasi promise
Note vargottama: same sign in both charts

slides.body: Chart readings show tendencies, not verdicts. Use them as a lens for reflection, not a final answer on your life.

slides.h2: See your D-1 and D-9 together
